title: Ngeli ya YA-YA (Theme 4: Misimu)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child knows ma- nouns with no singular (maji, maziwa, mafuta, mate) are YA-YA and take ya- in both.

floor.question: Ni nomino ipi ya wingi: maji, jiwe?

representations: a jug of water and a jar of oil
YA-YA and LI-YA cards to sort

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Maji yamechafuka" and one more with maziwa.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Maji ___meisha kisimani." Kwa nini "li" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Maji ni ya ngeli ya YA-YA. Hupatana na ya-: maji yameisha.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Maziwa ___meichacha jikoni." Kwa nini "i" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino za YA-YA hupatana na ya- tu.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Maziwa ___meichacha jikoni." Kwa nini "a" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: A- ni ya watu na wanyama. Maziwa ni kitu, na hupatana na ya-.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya YA-YA?" Kwa nini "kitabu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino za YA-YA hupatana na ya- na hazina umoja, kama maji.

checks.question: Ni nomino ipi ya YA-YA: majani, maziwa?
